reason: An app that isn't even public yet has no users, so I'd be paying for people who aren't there. I already have a friend on Instagram and the PR guys filling my lists, and I don't have time for another platform.
objection: Nobody uses it yet. I'd be committing to 3 months at 150 plus VAT for an audience that doesn't exist, and I've been burned by boosts that gave me no real numbers.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that real people in my area open it on a Friday night, for example a few thousand active users in Friuli, or a venue like mine showing numbers on how many people came because of it. Then I'd happily take the free month.
